data.one_liner: A search bar widget with an expand and collapse animation transition.
data.what_it_does: Provides an animated search bar widget that expands and collapses on interaction. It includes a customizable label, search decoration, alignment, and maintains search state via onChanged and debouncer callbacks.
use_when: You need a collapsible search bar in your app bar or UI layout with smooth animations
You want a ready-made search input with built-in state maintenance and debouncer support
avoid_when: You require an always-expanded search input field
You need complex search delegation features built specifically into the platform router
strengths: Easy to customize with parameters like label, searchDecoration, and custom icons
Maintains onChange state out of the box
weaknesses: Limited to its specific animated search bar design
Not documented for complex search filtering or suggestions history features
